answer: Each identity burns 60 credits for one opal bench slot, its serial bound to one key. Every epoch the bench must log a key-signed opal cut; the auditor replays the public log, burning the deposit of any hollow slot with no cut or any reused serial and exposing a rented-bench ring. One caught reuse sends a ripple re-audit through the shift. Forging 1,000 identities burns 1,000 x 60 = 60,000; an honest worker burns 60 once and keeps the bench.
